service.description: People the user may reach (search#Users) who have an active vault key, by name or username, as options {value (userId), label}; with recoveryHolders, only those who also hold VAULT_RECOVERY through a group, to split a recovery key to (the server refuses any other holder again).

The names of the users the caller's own vault records name (userIds, at most 200): the members of the vaults they are a member of, the signers of those vaults' member lists, the senders of their deliveries, the users whose keys they checked, and the makers and holders of the recovery keys and the people of the recoveries. Any other id, and a user the apps' chat-target providers refuse to the caller, is answered as itself, as one with no name.
The user groups that hold VAULT_RECOVERY, which a recovery key may be kept for (its userGroupId), by id or description, as options {value, label}.
